name: Dwarf Hammerer
tactics: A dwarf hammerer hates to give ground and stubbornly attacks any foe who attempts to push or knock her prone. A hammerer prefers close combat and charges headlong into battle at the first opportunity. The dwarf uses shield bash whenever possible, pushing allies back or knocking them prone so that nearby allies gain combat advantage.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description:
The heaviest type of armor, made up of shaped plates of metal or similarly resilient material, plate provides the most armor protection. The cost for its superior fortification is mobility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Plate armor grants +9 AC at levels 6-10, +10 AC at levels 11-15, +11 AC at levels 16-20, +12 AC at levels 21-25, and +14 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Heavy Shield
items.description: While you’re using a heavy shield, you can’t use your shield hand for any other task, since you must use that hand to handle the shield.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Stand the Ground
traits.details: The hammerer can move 1 square fewer than the effect specifies when subjected to a pull, push, or slide.

traits.name: Steady-Footed
traits.details: The hammerer can make a saving throw to avoid falling prone when an attack would knock it prone.

powers.name: Shield Bash
powers.requirements: The hammerer must be wielding a shield.

hit.description: damage, and the hammerer either knocks the target prone or pushes it 1 square.

powers.name: Stubborn
powers.trigger: An enemy tries to push the hammerer or knock it prone.

effect.description: The hammerer makes a melee basic attack against the triggering enemy.
